title: HiC Artifact Chain v1
description: The ordered post-generation pipeline (services/artifactChain.ts). stageOrder is the CONTRACT: a stage may be skipped by config, never reordered silently. services/artifactChain.test.ts pins the sequence and services/contracts.test.ts pins it against this file.

stageOrder.description: Order rationale: scrub before verifying (the verifier must see the reader's text); verify before counting slots (relabels settle first); measure prose on the final wording; grade after the other gates, because the grader also grades them; deckQuality last, because it judges the rendered shape and compares it to the previous deck in the engagement.

trace.description: One compact record per stage, for AIR. Decision fields only, never message text.

pass.description: False when any stage refused the artifact (narrow_scope) or errored.

repairInstruction.description: Concatenated model-facing repair text. Empty when everything passed.
